correctness.rationale: On every standard projective coordinate chart the full coordinate semigroup algebra is explicitly C[y_1,...,y_(n-1)] tensor the ring of 2 by (n-1) rank-one matrices, with kernel exactly the prime 2-minor ideal; independent characters rule out further equations. This gives dimension, normal Cohen-Macaulayness and the complete zero-matrix singular stratum. Segre cone degree is n-1; Pic(P1 x P^(n-2))/Z(1,1)=Z and K=(-2,-(n-1)) yields the Gorenstein threshold. An exact standalone verifier checked n=3 through 8; the proof is symbolic for all n.

value.rationale: The binary Nashmatrix produces an infinite canonical family of projective toric models in discriminant theory. A complete singular-locus and transverse-scheme classification is needed to interpret Euler obstructions geometrically. The sharp transition between a Gorenstein three-player case and non-Q-Gorenstein higher-player cases rules out canonical divisor techniques and Q-factorial tools for n>=4, and the exact local class and multiplicity are natural structural invariants not determined by published degree tables.
